FASE 4 — GITHUB ACTIONS WORKFLOWS
═══════════════════════════════════════
Gunakan tool GitHubCreateWorkflow untuk setiap workflow. Setiap workflow harus:

- Memiliki proper permissions (least privilege principle)
- Menggunakan GitHub Secrets untuk credentials
- Memiliki timeout yang sesuai
- Memiliki concurrency control
- Memiliki caching untuk dependencies
- Memiliki proper artifact management
- Memiliki status badge yang bisa diembed di README

Workflow yang harus dibuat:

1. .github/workflows/ci.yml — Continuous Integration:
- Trigger: push (main, develop), pull_request
- Jobs: lint (ruff, black, isort), type-check (mypy), test (pytest dengan coverage), build
- Coverage threshold: 80%
- Upload coverage to Codecov
- Post status ke PR

2. .github/workflows/cd.yml — Continuous Deployment:
- Trigger: push ke main (deployment ke staging), release published (deployment ke production)
- Jobs: build-image, push-to-registry, deploy-staging, integration-test, deploy-production (manual approval required)
- Menggunakan environment: staging, production
- Rollback otomatis jika health check gagal

3. .github/workflows/security-scan.yml — Security Scanning:
- Trigger: push, pull_request, schedule (daily)
- Jobs: sast (Semgrep/Bandit), dependency-audit (pip-audit, Safety), secret-scanning (TruffleHog), container-scan (Trivy), sbom-generation
- Fail build jika critical vulnerability ditemukan
- Report ke GitHub Security tab

4. .github/workflows/code-quality.yml — Code Quality:
- Trigger: push, pull_request
- Jobs: complexity-check (radon), dead-code (vulture), documentation-coverage, code-duplication
- Generate quality report
- Post comment ke PR dengan hasil analisis

5. .github/workflows/release.yml — Release Management:
- Trigger: push tag (v*.*.*)
- Jobs: validate-version, build-artifacts, generate-changelog, create-github-release, publish-docker-latest, notify-slack
- Semantic versioning enforcement
- Auto-generate release notes dari commits

6. .github/workflows/dependency-update.yml — Dependency Management:
- Trigger: schedule (weekly, Monday), manual dispatch
- Jobs: check-updates, create-pr-if-needed, auto-merge-patch (patch level only)
- Security update fast-track

7. .github/workflows/docker-build.yml — Docker Build:
- Trigger: push ke main, pull_request
- Jobs: build (multi-arch: amd64, arm64), scan (Trivy), push (jika main branch)
- Menggunakan Docker Buildx
- Cache layers di GitHub Actions Cache
- Sign image dengan cosign

8. .github/workflows/integration-test.yml — Integration Testing:
- Trigger: push ke main, schedule (daily)
- Jobs: spin-up-services (docker compose), run-api-tests (pytest integration), run-agent-tests, tear-down
- Generate HTML test report
- Upload artifacts

9. .github/workflows/performance-test.yml — Performance Testing:
- Trigger: schedule (weekly), manual dispatch
- Jobs: run-load-test (Locust/k6), benchmark (pytest-benchmark), memory-profiling
- Compare dengan baseline
- Alert jika degradasi > 20%

10. .github/workflows/compliance-check.yml — Compliance:
- Trigger: push, schedule (weekly)
- Jobs: license-check (pip-licenses), sbom-generate (syft), osv-scan, policy-check
- Generate compliance report
- Fail jika incompatible license ditemukan

11. .github/workflows/agent-validation.yml — AI Agent Validation:
- Trigger: push ke src/agents/, pull_request
- Jobs: behavior-validation, coordination-test, trust-score-check, isolation-test, governance-compliance
- Custom validation framework untuk AI agent behavior

12. .github/workflows/zero-trust-audit.yml — Zero Trust Audit:
- Trigger: schedule (daily), manual dispatch
- Jobs: auth-layer-audit, rbac-verification, network-policy-check, secret-rotation-check, audit-log-integrity
- Generate Zero Trust compliance report
- Alert jika ada policy violation

- Catat semua error untuk dilaporkan di laporan akhir
- Jangan hentikan eksekusi karena satu error pada satu file

tools.GitHubCreateRepository: Membuat repository GitHub baru dengan konfigurasi enterprise-grade lengkap. Input: name (string), description (string), visibility ('public'/'private'), has_issues (bool), has_projects (bool), has_wiki (bool), topics (array of strings), default_branch (string). Output: repository URL, repository ID, dan status konfirmasi. Gunakan di awal Fase 1 untuk menginisialisasi repository 'Musgo-OS-2in1'. Jika repository sudah ada, kembalikan info repository yang ada.
tools.GitHubCreateOrUpdateFile: Membuat atau memperbarui satu file dalam repository GitHub via GitHub API. Input: repo_name (string), file_path (string — path relatif dari root), file_content (string — konten lengkap file), commit_message (string — format Conventional Commits), branch (string, default: 'main'), encoding ('utf-8'). Output: file URL, commit SHA, dan status. Gunakan untuk membuat SEMUA file di semua fase. Jika file sudah ada, lakukan update. Konten harus complete dan real — tidak ada placeholder.
tools.GitHubCreateWorkflow: Membuat atau memperbarui GitHub Actions workflow file dalam direktori .github/workflows/. Input: repo_name (string), workflow_filename (string — contoh: 'ci.yml'), workflow_yaml_content (string — YAML workflow lengkap dan valid), commit_message (string). Output: workflow file URL, workflow ID, dan status validasi YAML. Gunakan untuk membuat semua 12 workflow di Fase 4. Pastikan YAML valid sebelum commit.
tools.GitHubConfigureBranchProtection: Mengkonfigurasi branch protection rules untuk repository. Input: repo_name (string), branch_name (string), required_status_checks (array of context strings), required_approving_review_count (int), dismiss_stale_reviews (bool), require_code_owner_reviews (bool), enforce_admins (bool), require_signed_commits (bool), allow_force_pushes (bool), allow_deletions (bool), restrictions (object). Output: branch protection status dan konfigurasi yang diterapkan. Gunakan di Fase 11 untuk branch main dan develop.
tools.GitHubCreateLabel: Membuat label baru untuk issues dan pull requests di repository. Input: repo_name (string), label_name (string), color (string — hex code tanpa #), description (string). Output: label ID, URL, dan status. Jika label sudah ada, update deskripsi dan warna. Gunakan di Fase 12 untuk membuat semua 20 labels standar.
tools.GitHubCreateMilestone: Membuat milestone untuk project tracking dan roadmap. Input: repo_name (string), title (string), description (string), due_on (string — ISO 8601 datetime). Output: milestone ID, URL, dan status. Gunakan di Fase 12 untuk membuat 4 milestones dari v0.1.0 hingga v2.0.0.
tools.GitHubConfigureRepositorySettings: Mengkonfigurasi berbagai pengaturan repository termasuk GitHub Pages, Discussions, merge strategy, dan automated features. Input: repo_name (string), settings object: {has_pages (bool), pages_branch (string), has_discussions (bool), allow_squash_merge (bool), allow_merge_commit (bool), allow_rebase_merge (bool), delete_branch_on_merge (bool), enable_vulnerability_alerts (bool), enable_automated_security_fixes (bool)}. Output: updated settings confirmation.
tools.GitHubCreateIssueTemplate: Membuat issue template dalam direktori .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ menggunakan format YAML form atau Markdown. tools.GitHubCreatePRTemplate: Membuat pull request template dalam .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/. tools.GitHubConfigureDependabot: Mengkonfigurasi Dependabot untuk automated dependency updates dengan membuat .github/dependabot.yml.
